reason: Plan Phase 5: the dimmed empty blade. A second cGUIObjTexture, allocated through its own DTI's MT allocator and constructed at its vftable slot 0x00, given the bar's transform, kind, owner, resource, texture id and atlas rectangle, coloured flat dark at all four corners, linked as the scissor mask's sibling on the row root's chain so it draws after the mask's subtree and outside the scissor. Its rect and atlas u are written each frame at the mask's enter handler: the rect runs from the cut's right edge to the bar rect's right edge, the atlas u is the same fraction of the authored 88 columns, so the copy keeps the blade's scale. It has no animation entry, so no keyframe writes it: constant, non-pulsing, and Txt_sharp's own keyframes untouched. The row's object array grows to 6 words and the draw block to 5 objects, 88 bytes = 11 records, exactly what the walker emits. Stages 50..52 mean no copy, which leaves the accepted r44 appearance. The MT color word's byte order is unproven, so the dark constant is byte-symmetric grey with the alpha byte written high and labelled as an inference; the facts line now prints the bar's four corner colours so a run pins the packing. r44's accepted behaviour and its 128 px-at-0%/200 px-at-100% endpoints are unchanged. 22 host fixtures pass; verify PASSED with the same 21 signature windows.
runtime_test: NOT RUN. The accepted cut is r44's, accepted on its Eden run of 2026-10-30. Phase 5 attempts on Eden 2026-10-31: r45 froze the game five seconds into both quest launches (vtable slot 0x00 is not a constructor on this class); r46 ran clean and refused its copy at stage 52 (the Texture setter resolves through *(obj+0x64), which the constructor zeroes); r47 and r48 ran clean and log the copy built, resolved and flagged drawable (records=11) with none of it visible in the sharpness gauge; r50 ran clean and its new quad log shows the placement landing where the accepted geometry says (rect 157..200, authored 43 at about 44% sharpness) while the copy's atlas window sat on the tier colour band. r51 puts that window back on u, the blade's length axis: the sprite's record says Txt_sharp is 88x24 with tier bands along v (0,280,88,304, 0,304,88,328, 0,328,88,352), so the v-axis window was my error. r51 has not been run.

target: MHGU Nintendo Switch 1.4.0; upstream Forge 1.5.1; Eden/Ryujinx. Base game and optional MHGU HD Project.
limitations: r4 has no runtime test; its lines, the 320-sample budget and the absence of any drawing change are static results.
r2 was built and never run; r3 was run once on Eden and is recorded.
r14 was run once on Eden and failed as reported: the gauge was clipped away from the insertion and the game crashed at the quest end. Its log is the evidence, and the insertion is removed in r15.

r15 was run once on Eden and drew the gauge normally for 740 seconds with no exception; its facts line printed tree_nodes 3 against 4 objects, and its object-list fields were read from the wrong object (the controller's owner field), which is what r16 fixes.

r16 changes nothing on screen: it reads game memory and logs. No drawing, no gauge change, and no cleanup claim (the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it). Its Eden run ended in Eden's own shutdown records (maxwell_3d Critical asserts, ForceStop, host SIGSEGV) with zero guest exceptions.
the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block r17 publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and r17 frees the old 4-word block itself
The per-weapon tier tables live in RomFS weapon data and are not read in this workspace: no weapon data file is extracted here.
The gauge itself is not part of r4.

r25 has not been run. r24's run drew the gauge from the quest start and lost it at an area change, where a mask kept clipping after its links broke; the disable-on-loss path has no runtime evidence, and a mask inserted into a second area's row has never been observed (r24's log ends 12 s after the transition, gauge HUD absent)
r40 has not been run. Its two defaults are the endpoints the r39 log shows applied (right edge 129 px at 0% and 201 px at 100%), read from the tester's run, not from an r40 run.
r42 has not been run. Its fill comes from the player fields Phase 1 verified and the r41 run's accepted geometry; the per-frame fill has not been seen on screen.
r43 has not been run. 128 px at 0% is proven by the r42 log (the tester dragged the start there); 200 px at 100% is the tester's measurement, and that run's box ended at 201.
The thread that runs the draw walker at main+0xa494a0 is unproven, and the run did not change that: no bl site, stored word or DTI property in main names that entry.
the dim blade appearing in the sharpness gauge: r47 and r48 report the copy built, resolved and flagged drawable, and the tester sees no copy there; r49 has not been run

The MT `color` word's byte order is unproven, so the dim blade's alpha byte position is an inference. The facts line now prints the bar's four corner colours, so a run pins it next to the colour on screen.

The r44 release bytes are preserved in backups/accepted/modern-sharpness-gauge/r44-before-dim-empty-blade/, runtime UNCHANGED; r45 through r50 are superseded; r51 is a new candidate and carries no distribution approval.

The Phase 5 construction, the texture resolve and its early return on a zero resource are read from the decompiles in work/research-tooling/ghidra-export. evidence.manual_summary: r44 ran once on Eden 2026-10-30 (installed NRO matched the packaged payload): 209 fill lines on bar rect 110 38 238 166 with feed=128, three insertions, three links-lost teardowns, no guest exception; the tester reported the cut where r43 put it with the HD Project on, which closed the HD Project question. r45's run (2026-10-31) froze the game: no insertion line on any path, then a guest null read at the gauge's first draw. r46's run (2026-10-31) had no fault and the accepted cut on screen; its line shows the copy was refused: 'records=9 dim=0x0' and 'dim blade not added at stage 52'. r47/r48/r50 ran clean with the copy in the tree and none of it visible in the sharpness gauge; r50's quad line proves the placement (rect 157..200, authored 43 at about 44%) with the window on the tier band axis. r51 has not been run. See EVIDENCE.json and backups/accepted/.
